Each emitter may consider a transfer only at its first subsequent native sample, persisted seen identities prevent later replay. Emitter metadata explicitly survives its native save override, offline observed-action delivery uses shared NativeQuestRecipients.

Emitter must have already natively sampled the same configuration/master before transfer

Native counter overflow, mismatching intervening stock/configuration/master state or later reuse of an observed transfer fails closed
